    The Cruz Azul vs. LAFC Concacaf Champions Cup match (April 14, 2026, at 9:00 PM ET) is available on TV via FS1 and TUDN. Streaming options include the FOX Sports app, Fubo (free trial), and TUDN platforms. The game is also available on Prime Video. 
    Where to Watch & Stream 
    • TV Channels: FS1, TUDN, FOX Sports 2
    • Streaming Services: Fubo (free trial), FOX Sports App/Web, TUDN.com, ViX
    • International: OneSoccer (Canada), Coupang Play (Korea)
    • Radio: 710 AM ESPN, ESPN LA App, KFWB 980 AM 
    The match takes place at Estadio Cuauhtémoc in Puebla, Mexico.
